Position Overview
We are seeking a hands-on, meticulous Python & AI Engineer to contribute to the design, development, and evolution of our Business Analytics platform.
You will work across the full backend stack, building RESTful APIs in Python FastAPI, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), designing agentic workflows using LangGraph, implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines with Weaviate vector search, and managing analytical data stores in ClickHouse. You will collaborate closely with senior engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to ship features, improve platform reliability, and contribute to technology innovation initiatives.
This is a high-impact, individual contributor role for someone who thrives at the intersection of backend engineering, applied AI, and data platform development.
Responsibilities
API Development & Backend Engineering by implementing RESTful API endpoints using FastAPI.
LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering for content generation, insight extraction, structured data parsing, and intelligent document analysis.
Build and extend AI agentic workflows using LangGraph defining state machines, tool nodes, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
Develop tool functions that agents invoke for data retrieval, LLM calls, and external system interactions.
Implement and maintain RAG pipelines using Weaviate as the vector database including document ingestion, chunking strategies, and hybrid search.
Build MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tool-use patterns.
Work with ClickHouse for analytical queries, data aggregation, and reporting.
Write and maintain tests using pytest, covering API endpoints, service functions, and integration scenarios.
Participate in code reviews, implement project conventions, and contribute to documentation (API docs, technical guides, runbooks).
Monitor and resolve production issues, diagnosing failures across the API layer, LLM calls, vector search, and database queries.
Qualifications
3 to 5 years of hands-on experience with Python development (FastAPI or similar frameworks). Working knowledge of R is a strong advantage.
Solid understanding of RESTful API design, Pydantic data validation, and sync/await patterns in Python.
Experience working with LLMs including prompt design and structured output handling.
Experience with LangChain or LangGraph for building agentic AI workflows.
Familiarity with vector databases (Weaviate, or similar) and RAG architecture.
Working knowledge of SQL databases, ability to write analytical queries, manage schemas, and work with columnar stores like ClickHouse is a plus.
Experience using AI-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code for accelerated code generation, debugging, and navigation.
Ability to perform end-to-end data science workflows: data collection, preprocessing, EDA, modeling, validation, and deployment.
Basic understanding of frontend technologies like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Familiarity of R Shiny to present data insights and model outputs is bonus.
Comfortable with Git workflows, code reviews, and task tracking tools (Jira).
Soft Skills & Attributes
Strong ownership approach who takes responsibility for features end-to-end, from design through deployment and support.
Structured and disciplined approach to code quality, naming conventions, and project standards.
Excellent communication skills with ability to discuss technical decisions with both engineering peers and business stakeholders.
Curious and self-driven learner who can keep up with the rapidly evolving landscape of LLMs, AI agents, and retrieval systems.
Proactive problem-solver who identifies root causes rather than applying surface-level fixes.
Detail-oriented with a focus on correctness, observability, and clean error handling.
Comfortable working independently while coordinating across a cross-functional team.

jobs.job_description:
Lead Applied AI / LLM Engineer

PERMANENT FULL-TIME OPPORTUNITY




RAG, Agents & Evaluation | Remote-first within India | Reports to the CTO




Experience: 37 years
Joining: ASAP; within 30 days preferred
Fixed salary: INR 24,00,00028,00,000 p.a.
Variable: Up to INR 3,00,000 p.a.
Location: Anywhere in India; Gurugram/NCR attendance as required
Work model: Flexible hours; core overlap 11:00 AM4:00 PM IST






The mandate:





AKS is building a permanent technical core of engineers who own outcomes, not isolated tickets. You will take end-to-end responsibility for applied AI systems across discovery, architecture, implementation, evaluation, deployment, UAT, production support, documentation and handover. You will coordinate directly with the CTO, collaborate with the full-stack lead and, where appropriate, guide interns or junior engineers while retaining accountability for the final result.




This is primarily an applied LLM and application-engineering role. Model training and research are part of the toolkit, but the central objective is to deliver reliable systems that work with real client data, constraints and acceptance criteria. A typical portfolio may include one or two active PoC/UAT builds and several systems in hypercare or maintenance.





What makes this role different:




AI coding agents and approved model/tool subscriptions are provided and encouraged. You remain accountable for architecture, correctness, security, tests and every accepted change. You must understand and be able to defend the system without relying on the tool that generated a suggestion.




What you will own

Convert ambiguous business and client problems into written technical outcomes, acceptance criteria and delivery plans.
Design, build and maintain production-oriented RAG, agentic and document-intelligence systems with explicit boundaries between deterministic logic, conventional ML and generative components.
Own ingestion, retrieval, embeddings, vector search, prompting, structured outputs, tool use, orchestration, guardrails and human-review paths.
Build defensible evaluations for retrieval quality, groundedness, citations, entity isolation, refusal behaviour, latency, cost and failure cases; turn production failures into regression tests.
Fine-tune models using LoRA or related parameter-efficient methods and deploy reproducible inference-serving workflows.
Develop production-quality Python services and APIs; integrate AI components with FastAPI applications, PostgreSQL/vector stores and frontend or workflow systems.
Deploy and troubleshoot services on cloud and client-controlled Linux/GPU environments using Docker, CI/CD, logging and monitoring.
Reuse proven components across applications without creating hidden coupling; improve existing repositories rather than rebuilding everything by default.
Maintain clear Git history, pull requests, tests, runbooks, architecture decisions, model/evaluation records and knowledge-transfer material.
Communicate progress, dependencies, risks and production incidents clearly to the CTO, delivery stakeholders and clients where required.
Review work and nurture interns or junior engineers when assigned; ownership cannot be delegated away.




Required capabilities

3–7 years of relevant software, ML or applied-AI experience, including personally shipped systems.
Strong Python engineering and hands-on PyTorch proficiency.
Strong foundations in statistics, statistical machine learning, deep learning, experimental design and practical model evaluation.
Production experience with LLM applications, RAG or agentic workflows; ability to diagnose retrieval, grounding, hallucination, identity and tool-use failures.
Hands-on LoRA fine-tuning and inference serving, including data preparation, baselines, leakage control, versioning, evaluation, capacity and rollback considerations.
Working knowledge of embeddings, vector databases, information retrieval, structured extraction and document-processing pipelines.
Strong Git and GitHub proficiency: branches, pull requests, reviewable commits, code review and repository hygiene.
Strong Linux, Docker, REST API, testing and debugging skills; working knowledge of CI/CD, monitoring and at least one cloud platform.
Ability to reason about security, privacy, client-data boundaries, model/provider selection, cost, latency and production fallback behaviour.
Clear written and verbal communication; direct client discovery or review experience is highly valued.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or another relevant quantitative discipline.




Preferred experience

Quantization, GPU-memory/performance optimization, vLLM or comparable model-serving frameworks.
PostgreSQL with pgvector or other vector stores; Pydantic/FastAPI; evaluation and observability tooling such as MLflow, Langfuse, Phoenix or OpenTelemetry.
Enterprise document intelligence, legal/research assistants, RFQ/quotation automation, voice/calling automation or other high-trust workflows.
Local/on-premise model deployment, distributed inference, Kubernetes or infrastructure-as-code.
Conventional ML problems such as classification, forecasting or ranking where labels, calibration and business-valid metrics matter.
Informal technical leadership, code review and guidance of interns/junior engineers.




Success in the first 90 days

Establish a verified architecture, data-flow, evaluation and deployment map for the assigned portfolio.
Reproduce existing baselines and known failures; resolve at least one bounded maintenance issue through a reviewed deployment.
Put representative evaluation/regression checks into the delivery workflow and ship one measurable reliability improvement.
Demonstrate a reproducible LoRA training and serving workflow in staging.
Lead one active PoC/UAT workstream while maintaining transparent status and risk control across 4–5 systems.
Deliver or materially advance one system to a written acceptance milestone and leave reusable, documented components behind.



Work model and support expectations

Permanent, full-time and remote-first within India. Attendance at the Gurugram office or client meetings may be required with reasonable notice.
Eight working hours on each scheduled workday, excluding breaks. The normal reference window is 9:30 AM–6:30 PM IST with a one-hour meal break; start/end times may flex while preserving mandatory availability from 11:00 AM–4:00 PM IST.
Regular Monday–Friday schedule plus two pre-notified working Saturdays per calendar month. The Saturday schedule is communicated before the month begins.
Routine overnight support is not expected. Exceptional production incidents may occasionally require availability outside normal hours, handled under company policy and applicable requirements.
Client travel is currently infrequent and primarily within NCR. Approved business travel outside NCR is reimbursed; other required travel arrangements are confirmed in advance.



Compensation and support

Annual fixed gross salary: INR 24,00,000–28,00,000.
Performance-linked variable pay: up to INR 3,00,000 per annum, assessed and payable quarterly against written, measurable outcomes. Variable pay is not guaranteed and may be prorated for eligible service.
Company-funded access to approved coding agents, model APIs and role-relevant software subscriptions.
Approved learning resources or certifications may be company-funded where relevant to delivery.
A company laptop/workstation may be provided based on role and information-security requirements.
Paid leave, holidays and statutory benefits in accordance with company policy and applicable law.



Selection process

Structured initial evidence and logistics screen with HR.
Technical architecture and ownership interview with the CTO.
Role-relevant synthetic work sample; approved coding agents may be used with disclosure and verification.
Final alignment and, where appropriate, consent-based reference or document verification.




Equal opportunity and accommodation

AKS Intelligent Systems LLP evaluates applicants on job-related capabilities and experience. Qualified candidates may request reasonable accommodation during the selection process. Please do not send Aadhaar, PAN, bank details or other sensitive identity documents with the initial application.




This job description summarizes the present role and is not an employment contract. Responsibilities may evolve with client and company priorities. Final terms are stated in the written offer and appointment documents.

To own MetisEI's AI agent layer end-to-end. We are rolling out approximately 30 agents spanning production, supply chain, quality, HR and finance. Several are already live at CT Mexico. These agents send reports and instructions directly to line managers and plant staff, largely over WhatsApp so reliability is the job, not a nice-to-have.




Key responsibilities:

Design, build and maintain the agent layer production efficiency reporting, workforce and absence reporting, supply chain, quality and finance agents.
Enforce the deterministic/LLM boundary. All arithmetic, thresholds, bucketing, ranking and fixed content must be computed and validated in code. The LLM is used for natural language rewriting of a pre-verified output only.
Build and maintain automated test suites and evaluation harnesses for every agent. Agents must be regression-tested before any prompt or logic change reaches a live recipient.
Build output validation that blocks a message from sending if it fails its rules, rather than relying on the model to comply.
Configure and operate the WhatsApp Business Platform (Meta Cloud API) business account and number setup, message template submission and approval, webhook handling, delivery and read receipts, error and retry handling, opt-in management, rate limits and quality rating.
Build scheduled delivery pipelines (daily and weekly cadences, timezone-correct per site) including PDF report generation and attachment.
Work directly with plant management and HR to specify agent behaviour, then translate that into testable rules.
Maintain a versioned content library (tips, templates, standard messaging) with verbatim-copy guarantees where required.



Essential requirements:

Strong Python. This role writes real software, not just prompts.
Hands-on production experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI or equivalent) not experimental or personal-project only.
Demonstrable experience building evaluation and testing frameworks for non-deterministic systems.
Practical understanding of where LLMs fail and how to constrain them structured output, validation, guardrails, fallbacks.
WhatsApp Business Platform / Meta Cloud API configuration experience, or equivalent messaging platform integration (Twilio, SMS gateways) with clear ability to pick up WhatsApp specifics.
Webhook and asynchronous job/scheduling experience.
Ability to work with non-technical stakeholders and convert loose requirements into precise, testable rules.



Desirable:

PDF and report generation.
Retrieval-augmented generation and vector databases (Qdrant).
Manufacturing or operations domain exposure.
Spanish.

Position Title: Software Engineer

Location: Mumbai, India (Hybrid)




The Area

The Morningstar Indexes Team leverages its expertise in equity research, manager research, asset allocation, and portfolio construction to create innovative investment solutions. It uses Morningstar’s intellectual property to create indexes that empower investors to achieve their goals at every stage of the investment process—market monitoring, benchmarking, and asset allocation. The fast-growing business offers a broad suite of global equity, bond, commodity and asset allocation indexes.




The Role

The Indexes Technology team is looking for a hands-on backend engineer with strong Python skills and working Java experience. You will build and maintain REST APIs, microservices, and data processing components that power Morningstar’s index and mutual fund data platforms, working in an Agile team alongside senior engineers who will invest in your growth. Our stack is Python-first (FastAPI, Pandas/NumPy, pytest) with established Java Spring Boot services, running on AWS with PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Docker.




Responsibilities

Develop backend applications and REST APIs using Python (FastAPI/Flask).
Contribute to enterprise applications built with Java Spring Boot.
Build and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices with clean, maintainable, well-tested code.
Write unit and integration tests (pytest, JUnit) and participate in code reviews and Agile ceremonies.
Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues across the stack.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams — team lead, business analysts, QA — to deliver high-quality software.
Learn and adopt modern development tools and engineering best practices, including AI-assisted development.



Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
3–5 years of backend development experience.
Python (primary): Strong proficiency in Python 3.x with FastAPI or Flask; REST API development and a solid understanding of microservices.
Pandas and NumPy for data processing.
Multiprocessing or multithreading fundamentals.
Robust exception handling; strong data structures and algorithms.
pytest for unit testing; dependency management with Poetry or uv.

Object-oriented programming, basic design patterns, and SOLID principles.
Git, debugging and troubleshooting skills, and Agile/Scrum experience.
Strong problem-solving ability, eagerness to learn, and good communication skills.



Good to Have

AWS fundamentals (S3, Lambda, ECS, RDS).
PostgreSQL / SQL.

Redis.

EOE Statement

Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.
